faq.question: Is coding mandatory for this course?
faq.answer: Basic coding helps, but the path is structured to ease you into practical analysis.

faq.question: What kind of projects will I complete?
faq.answer: You will work on datasets, reporting tasks, dashboards, and insight-driven presentations.

faq.question: Is this useful for analyst roles?
faq.answer: Yes. The course is designed around skills commonly expected in analytics and reporting roles.

tasks.title: Dirty Dataset Cleanup
tasks.assignment: Take a dirty CSV dataset with missing values and outliers, and clean it.
tasks.ai_review: The AI scans the code for specific functions like .dropna(), .fillna(), and data-type conversions to ensure the logic is structurally sound.

tasks.title: 3-Table SQL Join
tasks.assignment: Write an SQL query that joins three tables to find the highest-paying customers in a specific region.
tasks.ai_review: The AI executes the query against a virtual database. If the output matches the exact required monetary value, it is a Pass.

tasks.title: Dynamic Sales Dashboard
tasks.submission: A Plotly or D3.js configuration object.
tasks.assignment: Create a dynamic sales dashboard chart.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks the axes mapping, data labels, and whether the correct chart type such as Bar vs. Scatter was selected for the dataset.

tasks.title: House Price Regression
tasks.assignment: Train a basic Linear Regression model to predict house prices.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks for the train_test_split function and evaluates whether the student properly avoided data leakage.

tasks.title: Live API Reporting Pipeline
tasks.assignment: Build an automated script that pulls live API data, cleans it, runs a predictive model, and outputs a formatted summary report.
tasks.ai_review: The AI evaluates the full pipeline, checking API authentication, try/catch error handling, and the mathematical accuracy of the final model.
